draft.internal_notes: Data sources: order 1004 was retrieved with find_order. It belongs to customer@example.com (email matches sender). Suggest escalating to the fulfilment team to verify the delivery and the damage. Customer asked for no specific resolution yet. Medium urgency: concrete problem with an order, but the tone is disappointed rather than angry.
